messages:
rachel_csm: FYI - Lucentio onboarding shows stable p95 ~210ms but intermittent p99 jumps to ~1.05s during short query bursts. They care about UX consistency for chat widgets. Proposing a small canary: route short queries (<70 tokens) to compact-2b-int8 + enable prefix_kv with 10min TTL. Thoughts?

ops_bot: alert: customer=Lucentio window=14:10-14:30 p95=0.21s p99=1.05s spike_factor=3.1

omar_re: +1. Also suggest locking sampling params and add token-length normalization in the canary to catch tokenization regressions.

leo_eng: I can deploy a 4-hr canary with 30% of short-traffic hitting compact-2b-int8. Will collect per-model latency CDF, cache hit rate, and run the eval prompt set automatically. Plan to auto-spill to standard-3b if queue depth > 6.

sophia_pdm: Customer ok with minor quality change if latency + cost improve. Please capture a 20-sample golden set for manual QA.

leo_eng: Canary config snippet:
```json
{
  "customer":"lucentio",
  "filter":"short_tokens<70",
  "split":"30/70",
  "variants":["compact-2b-int8","standard-7b"],
  "cache":{"prefix_kv":true,"ttl_sec":600},
  "spillover":"standard-3b"
}
```

omar_re: Rollback: if eval quality drops >1% or p99 worsens vs baseline. I'll run the 20-sample QA after 1hr.

ops_bot: canary started 14:35 UTC. 30m update: median -16%, p95 -28%, p99 -22% for short queries, cache_hit=39%, spillovers=1.1%

rachel_csm: Great. If final eval stays within thresholds, I'll add this to the onboarding playbook and schedule enablement with the PM.

leo_eng: Canary completed. Auto-eval: quality delta -0.4%; cost sim ~33% savings. Marking PASS and recommending gradual rollout to prod route.
